title: Cross Platform C++ PS3 Repair CLI Roadmap

authorization.rule: Only bounded source research and planning updates are authorized. No development, incorporation, build/product test, installation, keys, device/console or publication action is authorized. Dependencies gate deliverable acceptance and downstream work; preliminary research does not close them.

proposed_project_root: TBD after explicit development authorization; this research folder contains planning documents only
completion_rule: Complete only for the exact advertised support tuples after all mandatory suite tracks and relevant gates pass. CLI-018/CLI-056 greater-than-2-TiB work and CLI-075 application database diagnostics are separately tracked optional extensions.

phases.name: Core interfaces crypto transports and independent fixtures
FAT VFLASH acquisition recovery backup and migration

gates.name: Requirements provenance and custody
gates.acceptance: Approved scope and source reuse decisions; operational custody validation is repeated at release.
gates.partial_source_evidence: INITIAL-RESEARCH.md; FORMAT-RESEARCH-2.md; PS3-NATIVE-RESEARCH.md; bounded source facts only; gate not assessed/passed

gates.name: PS3 format and repair specifications
gates.acceptance: Every admitted profile has byte-exact interpretation and action/refusal rules; FAT/VFLASH use additional gates.
gates.partial_source_evidence: INITIAL-RESEARCH.md; FORMAT-RESEARCH-2.md; PS3-NATIVE-RESEARCH.md; bounded source facts only; gate not assessed/passed

gates.name: Independent corpus and oracles
gates.acceptance: Independently constructed witnesses and expected outcomes do not depend solely on the implementation being judged.

gates.name: Shared core crypto and image I O
gates.acceptance: Source review, target compilation and generated/image checks are recorded separately.

gates.name: Complete bounded UFS2 inspection
gates.acceptance: All supported invariants and dependent ownership have coverage; unknowns prevent global clean/reclaim conclusions.

gates.name: Reviewable repair plans and overlays
gates.acceptance: Plans are deterministic, evidence-bound, byte-allowlisted and verified on isolated overlays.

gates.name: Image repair and transaction recovery
gates.acceptance: Every supported action and transaction failure point preserves verified recovery or explicit uncertainty.

gates.name: Per platform physical device qualification
gates.acceptance: Windows Linux and macOS qualify independently for each operation/backend/architecture.

gates.name: Per profile PS3 console acceptance
gates.acceptance: Advertised console profiles pass exact approved native plans; greater than 2 TiB remains separate CLI-056.

gates.name: FAT filesystem checking and repair
gates.acceptance: FAT12/16/32 each have independent checking, repair and recovery evidence.

gates.name: Nested VFLASH and partition repair
gates.acceptance: Critical region and disklabel operations have their own preservation and native compatibility acceptance.

gates.name: Acquisition recovery backup and migration
gates.acceptance: Coverage and source custody remain explicit across companion operations; optional database diagnostics are separate.

gates.name: Complete suite release
gates.acceptance: Only exact advertised tuples with accepted evidence may be distributed as the complete suite.

tasks.title: Define suite requirements and completion contract
acceptance: Every promised operation and excluded or optional extension has a named support profile and measurable outcome.

tasks.title: Resolve source provenance and file level reuse terms
acceptance: Each candidate file has a pinned origin, licence decision, notices and permitted reuse category; unresolved material cannot be incorporated.
tasks.research_remaining: Additional BSD comparator notices inventoried; contribution grants, selected composition and complete included-file/dependency review remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Specify operation and hardware profile ledger
acceptance: Ledger distinguishes image, host, backend, console crypto, filesystem dialect, geometry, capacity and read/write/recovery acceptance.

tasks.title: Define preservation permissions and privacy boundaries
acceptance: Planning authority cannot enable code execution or hardware actions; future evidence excludes secrets and uncontrolled user payload.

tasks.title: Specify evidence findings and gate records
acceptance: Every result binds source revision, exact inputs, independent oracle, capability tuple, limitations and coverage.

tasks.title: Select build dependency and maintenance policy
acceptance: C/C++ standards, compilers, supported dependency versions, offline/reproducible acquisition and upgrade policy are reviewed without installing them.

tasks.title: Research PS3 disklabels partition bounds and nested maps
acceptance: Field layout, table variants, overlap rules and VFLASH nesting have independent corroboration; ambiguous maps remain unwritable.
tasks.research_remaining: Reserved region, ACLs, roles, variants, competing/damaged-map authority and independent cases remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Research and reconcile console crypto profiles
deliverables: Crypto profile and generated vector specification
acceptance: CBC/XTS, layer order, byte swaps, sector origin and supplied key forms are explicit for each profile, beyond NAND/NOR shorthand.
tasks.research_remaining: Named model/firmware profile matrix and independent known answers for exact layers/origins/key kinds remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Resolve all address and allocation units
acceptance: Host logical/physical units, crypto sectors, fragments, fsbtodb and di_blocks conventions are independently specified; 4Kn is explicit.
tasks.research_remaining: Native globals/setter and IDENTIFY normalization predicate bound; complete lifecycle/aliases/resets, caller field semantics, cross-profile/mixed-image consistency and writable unit admission remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Research superblocks replicas and feature flags
acceptance: Primary/alternate selection, byte preservation, known/unknown flags and supported formats have deterministic or refuse rules.
tasks.research_remaining: Selected native clean/flag/legacy marker paths bound; complete feature consumers, legacy writes, pending/snapshot transitions and replica/failure policy remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Resolve cylinder groups and initialized inode prefixes
deliverables: Cylinder group and inode initialization specification
acceptance: cg_initediblk units and corrupt-prefix fallback are resolved; partial last groups, metadata reservations and lazy initialization are specified.
tasks.research_remaining: Native kernel mutation/submission order and distinct checker allocation bound; callback/dependency completion/error/retry, durable ordering, later publication and damaged-state arbitration remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Research inode extents sparse tails links and attributes
acceptance: Direct through triple-indirect holes, pointer metadata, PS3 tail rules, inline links, external attributes and special nodes are mapped.
tasks.research_remaining: Native BE seven-byte EA framing, VOP bindings and access predicates established; actual names/value consumers, full security enforcement, malformed/persistence behavior and cross-profile evidence remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Research directory graph and raw name conventions
acceptance: Record boundaries, byte names, dot entries, parent relationships, hard links and export collisions are specified.

tasks.title: Research dirty soft update and unsupported feature states
deliverables: Dirty and feature state decision table
acceptance: Pending frees and dirty markers are distinguished from disposable allocations; unsupported features retain preservation and refusal policies.
tasks.research_remaining: Native flag/dependency/initialization paths bound; complete pending/dirty transitions, consumers, stable-write/failure semantics and safe allocation/clean-state repair remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Define repair and salvage decision catalogue
acceptance: Each action declares evidence, full ownership prerequisites, postconditions, changed ranges and refusal/ambiguity behavior.

tasks.title: Research FAT12 FAT16 and FAT32 variants
acceptance: FAT copies, chains, directories, long names, bad/reserved clusters and FAT32 auxiliary metadata have profile-specific rules.

tasks.title: Research VFLASH region roles and safe restoration
acceptance: Nested region roles, critical metadata, preservation and console consequences are established before any repair plan.

tasks.title: Audit greater than 2 TiB addressing as a separate extension
acceptance: Sector index/tweak width, arithmetic and console/firmware requirements remain separate; no host-only result qualifies console support.

tasks.title: Derive memory work recursion and scratch budgets
acceptance: Limits account for initialized placement, all ownership records, diagnostics, repair growth and failure reserves; unknown costs remain explicit.

tasks.title: Specify independent corpus and oracle construction
acceptance: Fixture construction and judging are independent; every known upstream defect has a planned witness and expected outcome.

tasks.title: Specify reusable core context and error interfaces
acceptance: Per-run contexts, explicit coverage, checked byte I/O and no hidden writes replace process globals and implicit finalization.

tasks.title: Specify journal transaction and overlay state machines
acceptance: All writes and durable publication transitions have before-image, precondition, failure, originally-dirty rollback and resume rules.

tasks.title: Specify capture unreadable map and archive formats
acceptance: Capture can resume safely, records unknown ranges without fabricated zeros, and binds identity/profile while preserving raw encrypted bytes.

tasks.title: Specify CLI results key input and machine reports
acceptance: Exit/result distinctions, secure key input, cancellation, dry-run/plan approval and terminal-safe raw names are documented.

tasks.title: Specify equivalent device backend contracts
acceptance: Exact I/O, full bounds, identity, exclusion, permissions, flush failure and hotplug behavior are defined per OS and bridge.

tasks.title: Adapt audited native key derivation and crypto components
deliverables: Native crypto library and vector evidence
acceptance: Independent generated known answers cover all admitted layers and high/unaligned boundaries; no real key material is required.

tasks.title: Implement checked regular image transport
acceptance: Short/failed reads never return invented success, seeks and conversions are checked, read-only is enforced, flush failures propagate.

tasks.title: Implement Windows raw transport adapter
acceptance: Identity, exclusion, aligned I/O and durability errors satisfy the common contract in mocks before disposable-media qualification.

tasks.title: Implement Linux raw transport adapter
acceptance: Linux identity, mount exclusion, aligned positional I/O, cancellation and durable flush semantics are independently tested.

tasks.title: Implement macOS raw transport adapter
acceptance: macOS device identity, exclusion/automount handling, raw I/O and persistence/error semantics have independent tests.

tasks.title: Implement bounded disklabel and crypto profile discovery
deliverables: Disk layout and profile discovery library
acceptance: Partition ends and nested views are bounded; competing valid candidates or crypto interpretations prevent repair admission.

tasks.title: Implement checked PS3 UFS2 decoding
deliverables: PS3 UFS2 decoder and corruption tests
acceptance: Every field is decoded with explicit units and checked ranges; unknown bytes are preserved and unsupported states reported.

tasks.title: Implement one logical extent and ownership iterator
deliverables: Unified extent iterator and independent tests
acceptance: Data, holes, indirect metadata, EAs and reserved references retain logical positions and exact fragment lengths in every caller.

tasks.title: Implement full inode and fragment ownership checking
acceptance: Complete supported-domain scans detect all ownership conflicts including same-inode aliases; unknown regions prevent global conclusions.

tasks.title: Implement directory connectivity and link checking
deliverables: Directory graph and reference scan passes
acceptance: Root, raw names, dot entries, cycles, parents and all reference counts are reconciled without silently skipped reads.

tasks.title: Implement independent allocation and summary reconstruction
acceptance: CG maps, partial group bounds, fragment/cluster summaries and global copies derive from complete ownership rather than corrupt totals.

tasks.title: Implement coverage aware scanner reports
acceptance: Consistent, inconsistent, incomplete, unsupported and aborted outcomes are distinct and backed by a coverage map; no writes occur.

tasks.title: Enforce resource limits and cancellation
acceptance: Corrupt input, allocation/scratch exhaustion and cancellation end within declared budgets without writes or false clean outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement read-only extraction and content verification
acceptance: Extraction preserves content positions and raw-name mapping, reports unreadable bytes and separates hashes from original-content proof. Output paths stay confined to the selected destination despite raw names, symlinks, hardlinks and platform-normalization collisions.

tasks.title: Implement degraded metadata discovery and salvage
acceptance: Alternate structures and damaged prefixes yield bounded evidence/confidence; ambiguous reconstruction remains export-only or refused.

tasks.title: Implement orphan reconnection and duplicate ownership planning
acceptance: Disconnected trees and competing owners have explicit preservation policies; no global reclaim is based on incomplete traversal.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic UFS2 repair planning
acceptance: Every proposed counter/map/link/record correction has checked dependencies and byte preconditions, with no direct target writes.

tasks.title: Implement isolated repair overlay representation
acceptance: All algorithm writes go to a bounded inspectable overlay; crash/reopen format, overlapping sectors and base identity are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement plan preview and approval binding
deliverables: Repair plan export and review interface
acceptance: Plan binds input identity/digests/profile/policy and expected changes; stale or modified inputs invalidate apply admission.

tasks.title: Implement durable encrypted before-image journals
acceptance: Every overwritten physical/crypto span is fully captured durably first; dirty originals and directory/EA updates are supported.

tasks.title: Implement checked repair commit state machine
acceptance: No destructor writes; target changes are allowlisted and ordered, every error preserves primary status and recovery evidence.

tasks.title: Implement restart resume and verified rollback
acceptance: Wrong identities/versions/external changes are rejected; repeated or interrupted recovery restores the original supported state or reports uncertainty.

tasks.title: Implement independent post-repair verification
acceptance: Changed sectors match the plan, unaffected content is preserved, independent invariants hold and clean promotion requires complete verification.

tasks.title: Build independent fixture oracle and failure injection harness
deliverables: Generated corpus and independent fault harness
acceptance: Independent construction/oracles expose intentionally seeded expectation errors and support every I/O/publication failure point.

tasks.title: Qualify image repair and crash recovery
acceptance: All admitted image profiles pass action/refusal cases and the complete transaction cut-point matrix; failures remain recoverable and explicit.

tasks.title: Qualify physical backends separately on each OS
acceptance: Each named OS/arch/backend/device tuple proves exclusion, readback, durability/error and hotplug behavior under a separately authorized disposable-media plan.

tasks.title: Qualify NAND CBC PS3 console compatibility
acceptance: Exact disposable/copy profile preserves agreed bytes/metadata and passes approved console checks; console mutation is independently recorded.

tasks.title: Qualify fat NOR crypto and layout profiles
acceptance: Actual outer CBC/XTS and nested layer profile is proven rather than inferred from NOR; console acceptance is separate for each admitted layout.

tasks.title: Qualify Slim XTS console compatibility
acceptance: XTS sector origin, metadata behavior and approved console workload are independently verified on the exact supported profile.

tasks.title: Qualify observed alternate 512e accounting profiles
acceptance: Source accounting conventions survive repair and native reuse; host physical-sector presentation alone cannot select the convention.

tasks.title: Qualify greater than 2 TiB extension if separately pursued
acceptance: Host addressing and applicable firmware/console high-LBA compatibility are independently qualified; no ordinary-profile result is transferred.

tasks.title: Implement and qualify FAT12 FAT16 FAT32 checking
acceptance: FAT copies/chains, names, cross-links, loops and auxiliary metadata have complete coverage and independent corruption oracles.

tasks.title: Implement and qualify FAT repair transactions
acceptance: FAT-specific plans preserve unrelated data, explain copy arbitration and survive action/refusal and interrupted-recovery cases.

tasks.title: Implement and qualify nested VFLASH inspection and backup
acceptance: Nested regions and layer addressing remain bounded; independent backups and read-only results are verified before repair admission.

tasks.title: Qualify VFLASH repair on disposable console media
acceptance: Exact role/profile restoration and separately approved console recovery outcomes are verified; UFS acceptance is not inherited.

tasks.title: Implement resumable encrypted acquisition and read maps
acceptance: Capture binds identity, retains unreadable intervals, resumes without fabricating content and verifies completed readable ranges. Corrupt/truncated/swapped or stale read maps and interrupted checkpoint publication cannot mark unread intervals complete.

tasks.title: Implement preservation archives with explicit coverage
acceptance: Archive manifests distinguish complete raw capture from allocation-based backup and preserve uncertainty when maps are damaged. Payload hashes, manifest/range integrity, ordering and truncation checks are validated before restore.

tasks.title: Implement file tree and orphan export recovery
acceptance: Recovered paths/bytes/confidence and collisions are explicit; partial or guessed reconstructions never become verified originals.

tasks.title: Port and qualify file level migration
acceptance: Hard links, holes, raw names, EAs and content verification retain separate source-change, preservation and rollback gates.

tasks.title: Qualify archive restore and source preservation
acceptance: Restore preserves all archived admitted bytes and metadata, rejects coverage gaps/mismatched targets and does not overwrite sources. Hostile path records, swapped payloads/manifests and incomplete checkpoint publications are rejected before destination writes.

tasks.title: Integrate suite commands and structured outcomes
deliverables: CLI command suite and report schema
acceptance: All commands share explicit capabilities, coverage, stable report versions, cancellation and nonzero incomplete/failed results.

tasks.title: Establish three OS build and image validation matrix
acceptance: Every advertised host/architecture compiles and passes appropriate generated/image checks with locked dependencies; hardware results remain separate.

tasks.title: Qualify bounded performance without weakening checks
acceptance: Caches/batching preserve exact results and recovery semantics; CPU/memory/scratch/throughput are measured on labelled workloads.

tasks.title: Prepare notices dependency inventory and packages
acceptance: All distributed components have resolved provenance and locked hashes, reproducible build inputs and notices.

tasks.title: Write operating recovery and support documentation
acceptance: Instructions match qualified operations, preserve originals, explain incomplete outcomes and retain a usable recovery-version route.

tasks.title: Review exact suite release and support claims
deliverables: Independent release review and support ledger
acceptance: Every advertised tuple and operation has accepted evidence; unsupported capacity/architecture/features are explicit and no required suite track disappears.

tasks.title: Package and publish only explicitly authorized releases
acceptance: Exact artifacts match reviewed hashes/notices and per-host smoke evidence; publication occurs only under later explicit authority.

tasks.title: Define post-repair native growth and recovery limits
acceptance: Host-repaired structures are not promised to remain natively repairable under arbitrary later growth; supported/refusal/recovery behavior is documented.

tasks.title: Define source updates vulnerability response and journal compatibility
acceptance: Source updates rerun affected gates, reports/journals have explicit compatibility and old recovery paths remain available.

tasks.title: Research optional XMB database diagnostics
acceptance: Application database diagnostics have separate schemas and evidence; filesystem repair does not claim database or licence validity.

tasks.title: Review complete resource and scratch admission
acceptance: Worst admitted layouts and failure-path work fit explicit budgets; OOM/scratch exhaustion cannot produce partial clean or reclaim permission.

tasks.title: Research deterministic damaged partition reconstruction
acceptance: Multiple independent structures corroborate exact starts/lengths/roles; ambiguous tables remain preserved and export-only.

tasks.title: Qualify bounded partition repair transactions
acceptance: Whole-device/nested table changes have independent before-image and role checks, interrupted recovery and exact later native acceptance where applicable.

tasks.title: Qualify multi-device identity privacy and source custody
acceptance: Source/destination swaps, hotplug, lookalike names, logs and secret handling cannot cause source writes or private key disclosure.

tasks.title: Accept complete advertised suite across the support ledger
acceptance: Required UFS2 FAT VFLASH partition acquisition recovery backup and migration tracks all close for advertised profiles; partial milestones retain partial labels.

tasks.title: Qualify dev_hdd1 FAT32 console cache repair
acceptance: Exact dev_hdd1 role/profile repair passes independent host checks and separately approved console use on disposable/restorable copies, per advertised backend; generic FAT image results alone are insufficient.

tasks.title: Qualify fuzzing and native memory safety across input formats
deliverables: Native input hardening and fuzz qualification report
acceptance: Generated corrupt disk/filesystem/overlay/journal/archive/report inputs pass applicable memory/undefined-behavior sanitizers and coverage-guided fuzz campaigns with declared budgets and independently reviewed coverage; exhaustion/failures remain explicit.

tasks.title: Qualify confined extraction and untrusted archive recovery
deliverables: Destination confinement and archive trust qualification
acceptance: Raw names, symlinks, hardlinks, path collisions and hostile manifests cannot escape the selected export/restore target; corrupt/swapped capture maps or archives cannot certify unread bytes or trigger writes.
